# Real Estate With Shirin

> Real Estate With Shirin is the customer-facing practice of Shirin Abplanalp, a licensed North Idaho REALTOR® and Seniors Real Estate Specialist (SRES®) with Berkshire Hathaway HomeServices Jacklin Real Estate. She helps buyers, sellers, and relocating families in Post Falls, Coeur d'Alene, Hayden, Rathdrum, and Sandpoint. 11 years of experience, 100+ transactions closed.

## Identity
- Brand: Real Estate With Shirin (this website)
- Person: Shirin Abplanalp, licensed REALTOR®, SRES®, Idaho License #1371861
- Brokerage: Berkshire Hathaway HomeServices Jacklin Real Estate (jacklinrealestate.com)

## About
Licensed Idaho REALTOR® (License #1371861), SRES® (Seniors Real Estate Specialist), member of the National Association of REALTORS® and the Coeur d'Alene Association of REALTORS®. Markets: Post Falls, Coeur d'Alene, Hayden, Rathdrum, Sandpoint, Kootenai County, and Bonner County.
